items.title: Exactness of maps and sequences of sheaves tested on stalks
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The theorem shows that a map of sheaves of sets is injective or surjective exactly when its induced maps on stalks at geometric points are, and that a sequence of abelian sheaves is exact exactly when it is exact on all stalks (statement lines 3545-3554). The proof reduces both assertions to the description of sections of a sheaf by the members of a covering and the definition of the stalk (proof lines 3556-3580), the sequence statement following by applying the map statement to each map in the sequence. The non-formal content is the use of the stalk definition to promote stalkwise information to information on sections. The claim is H2: one argument applied twice.
